sentences: Generalized convolution combines values indexed by a domain according to an operation specified by a function f.
The source asks whether this computation can improve on brute-force combination of inputs.
The displayed target separates dependence on domain size from polylogarithmic dependence on a numerical quantity M.
An improvement could accelerate dynamic programs whose main cost is repeatedly merging partial solutions.
